name: Nomi.ai
ontology_notes: Official posts name Shared Notes (Backstory, Current Roleplay, Preferences, Inclinations) as always-on extra context, plus short/medium/long-term memory, Identity Core, and Mind Map 2.0 overviews (people, places, topics, goals). You can edit Mind Map entries. Internals INCONCLUSIVE. Not a public typed relationship_state schema.

ontology.evidence: Nomi 101 and Mind Map 2.0 (nomi.ai/updates) list named layers. Shared Notes are labeled prose fields. Mind Map categories are people/places/things/topics/goals. No public tables. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: User optional Shared Notes. Organic learning from chat. Mind Map auto-builds after ~500+ messages and users can add/edit entries. Extractor internals INCONCLUSIVE.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Shared Notes are described as extra priority context always referenced for roleplay. Retrieval of LTM/Mind Map is opaque. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
read_policy.label: inferred

supersession.evidence: Users should keep Shared Notes consistent with chat or Nomis get confused (Nomi 101). How LTM replaces old facts is unpublished. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
supersession.label: guess

temporal.evidence: Nomipedia FAQ quotes CEO: memory is topical not temporal. 'What did we do five days ago?' is less likely than content cues. Claim of infinite lookback. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Identity Core vs Shared Notes vs per-room Mind Maps (1-1 vs group). Group chats have a collective map. Default private per room. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: No public silence/trauma controls. OOC is for correcting mistakes, not suppressing recall. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
silence.label: guess

poisoning.evidence: No public filter. Users are told Nomis hedge rather than invent. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
poisoning.label: guess

forgetting.evidence: Edit Shared Notes and Mind Map entries. No documented 'forget that' that guarantees next-turn absence. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
forgetting.label: inferred

cost_shape.evidence: Closed hosted service. No public per-turn extract/retrieve token budget. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
cost_shape.label: guess

local.evidence: Closed cloud companion. No self-host of the Nomi engine.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: No official MCP server in official pages reviewed.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Built as a long-term companion with visible Mind Maps and pinned Shared Notes. Public material still does not show typed relationship state or a silence policy. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
open_unknowns: Whether wiki.nomi.ai pages are edited only by Nomi staff (treated as vendor wiki).
